title: Profit-target level and partial-exit recipe

target_id.description: stable within version;updates do not replace another target. Omitted means no change;remove is explicit operation

operation.description: exact target/version scope. Removal never removes protective stop

role.description: required for add/update. Provider intent preserved unless released policy states otherwise

reference_basis.description: required for add/update;product-compatible. No raw price basis inference

level.description: required for add/update;profile-valid domain. No invented level when source supplied none

reduction_basis.description: required for partial exit. Exact quantity-conserving semantics

reduction_fraction.description: required for partial exit;0<value<=1. Server cumulative rounding avoids excess sales

rounding_policy_id.description: required for partial exit;verified instrument step. Small allocations may not support every trim

trail_recipe_id.description: required for trailing_trigger. Activating a trail is not automatically an immediate sale

description: Ready-input schema plus server business validation. Draft input uses identical property types but permits missing required fields; missingness must be displayed. Identity/password forms never saved as drafts.
